notes: An employee's documents now include the letters the company issued them, not just the files they uploaded. Open anyone in the Directory and their offer letter and appointment letter are listed alongside their PAN, Aadhaar and certificates — waiting to be verified, the same way everything else there is. Releasing a letter to a candidate and confirming the copy filed on their record are two different checks, so HR still has the last word on both. Document types also read properly now — “Appointment Letter” instead of “AppointmentLetter” — and every file says where it came from, so an issued letter is never mistaken for something the employee sent in. Alongside this build, the appointment letter email carries its download link again: the wording had been edited in Templates and the link went with it, so candidates were getting the attachment and nothing else. The link is now guaranteed on every letter email whatever the wording says, and a letter that cannot be read is refused instead of quietly emailing an empty envelope. Also in this build, from 2.8.0: people who have left no longer appear in any picker or on the org chart; HR Managers see and manage every employee in their own company; a Super Admin can grant an HR the “Leave approval hierarchy” screen; and the number of free late arrivals each month is a setting, given in full to everyone every month including their first.
